<infobox theme="Other-Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="author"><label>Author(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="editor"><label>Editor(s)</label></data>			
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="website"><label>Website</label></data>	
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>Release date</label></data>	
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>	
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>	
        <data source="preceded by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
        <data source="followed by"><label>Followed by</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:WebArticle|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|author|editor|website|publisher|release date|series|preceded by|followed by|optional=no_year_check,is_appearance|ignore=name}}{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|template_name=WebArticle|misc=1|image_optional=1}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{{is_appearance|}}}|{{AppMediaCat}}|}}<noinclude>[[category:Media infoboxes]]{{Clear}}

==Usage instructions==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate field.
<pre><nowiki>
{{WebArticle
|image=
|title=
|author=
|editor=
|website=
|publisher=
|release date=
|series=
|preceded by=
|followed by=
}}
</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
